title: Clubs across the river and getting his own clarinet
summary: After a phone interruption, Ford names the Moulin Rouge, Specs and the Moonlight Inn, and tells how his uncle repaired an old Albert-system clarinet that became his first instrument.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
